cover_letter.greeting: Dear Example Cloud Co Hiring Team,

paragraphs.text: I'm applying for the Customer Success Manager role helping small businesses get the most from Example Cloud Co. Turning new customers into long-term partners is the work I enjoy most, and my background lines up in three ways.
At Sample Software Inc, I manage 60+ business accounts through onboarding, regular check-ins and renewal conversations.
I built 12 training guides and recorded walkthroughs that customers use during onboarding, so they reach value faster.
Four years in technical support taught me to troubleshoot calmly, document issues well and keep customers informed.
I work daily in Salesforce, Zendesk and Microsoft 365, and I use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to prepare account reviews faster.
Work samples are available upon request, and my resume is attached. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help your customers grow with Example Cloud Co.
Thank you for your time and consideration.
